## What they do

Mitochondria produce most of the energy a cell spends, as ATP [1]. A liver cell can hold as many as two thousand of them [1].

## Inheritance

Mitochondrial DNA is passed down from the mother alone.
Fathers contribute none of it [2].

## Sources
1. Cells — https://example.org/cells
2. Genes — https://example.org/genes

# Maternal inheritance

> Mitochondrial DNA comes from the mother.

## Inheritance

Mitochondrial DNA is passed down from the mother alone.[^What-do-mitochondria-do]
Fathers contribute none of it [2].

## Sources
1. Cells — https://example.org/cells
2. Genes — https://example.org/genes
